lifecycle.retention: Retain editable logical subject and pinned provenance; product implementation/acceptance are separate records.

body.value:
Collector snapshot поддерживает только уже известные `Connection` типы:
vector/PostGIS и `qgis_vector_style`/`qgis_raster_style`. Style resource имеет
собственный remote id для tile URL/identity, parent id только для extent и
никогда не становится редактируемым. Не добавляй в `Connection.java` новые
resource classes ради Collector без отдельного продуктового решения.

review.value: Keep exact supported vector/PostGIS/style classes, separate style identity and parent extent, no editing or speculative Connection classes.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
